rule: Announced is not closed. The graph shows who controls the outlet today, not who would if a deal finished.

deals.headline: Paramount–WBD is not closed
deals.body: DOJ cleared Paramount Skydance's purchase of Warner Bros. Discovery in June 2026. Twelve state attorneys general sued in July. Paramount stipulated it will not close until a trial ruling or 1 June 2027, whichever comes first. Trial is set for March 2027. CNN stays at WBD. The Ellison family does not control CNN today.

deals.headline: NBCUniversal spin is announced, not closed
deals.body: Comcast said 29 June 2026 it will tax-free spin NBCUniversal and Sky into a separate public company around mid-2027. Dual-class Roberts control is planned to carry over. NBC News and MSNBC remain inside Comcast until that closes.
